Hadith.955 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"When one of you finishes the prayer, let him raise his hands to the sky and be earnest in supplication."
Ibn Saba asked: "O’ Commander of the Faithful, is not Allah (swt) present everywhere?"
He (Imam Ali) replied: "Indeed, He is."
Ibn Saba then asked: "So why do we raise our hands towards the sky?"
Imam Ali answered, "Do you not recite: '
And in the heaven is your sustenance and what you are promised' (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:22)?
From where else should sustenance be sought except from its place, and the place of sustenance and Allah’s (swt) promise is in the sky."
